column2: This campaign depicts many of the most important events in the struggle of British arms during world war II. The British were significantly handicapped in regards to land based weapons. The German weaponry was generally superior. They have very competitive pl anes and a vast superiority on sea to balance this negative fact. The infantry was good and their morale was high. Their tanks and guns were very inferior to equivalent German and Soviet models though. These facts will appear reflected in the campaign and the player should take them into account.
column3: 本战役描绘了二战中英国军事斗争里许多最重要的事件。英国在陆基武器方面明显处于劣势。德国的武器总体上更优越。他们拥有很有竞争力的飞机和巨大的海上优势，以抵消这一不利因素。步兵素质不错，士气也高。不过他们的坦克和火炮与同级的德国和苏联型号相比差得多。这些事实会体现在战役中，玩家应当把它们考虑在内。

column2: This campaign is significantly different from the one designed by Mr. William Dickens. Seven scenarios are completely new and four more have gone through complete renovation. Some of the scenarios have been inspired on similar ones designed by Steve Brown. They are very different from Steve's scenarios though.
column3: 本战役与 William Dickens 先生设计的那个战役有显著不同。有七个场景是全新的，另外四个经过了彻底翻新。有些场景的灵感来自 Steve Brown 设计的类似场景。不过它们与 Steve 的场景差别很大。

column2: My new efile that features stronger infantry and higher prices for heavy weapons is particularly suitable for this campaign. There are hard terrain and city-fighting scenarios where the stronger infantry is actually superior to tanks. The AI plays particularly aggressive with the infantry in cities, counterattacking often and punishing mistakes, increasing the interest of the game. Higher prices for heavy weapons, lower than other efiles though, guarantee that players will not upset the balance by buying too many heavy weapons.
column3: 我的新装备文件增强了步兵，并提高了重型武器的价格，特别适合这个战役。在艰难地形和城市战场景里，更强的步兵实际上比坦克更占优势。AI 在城市中使用步兵时特别有攻击性，经常反击，惩罚失误，这增加了游戏的趣味。重型武器的价格更高(不过仍低于其他装备文件)，可以保证玩家不会因为买太多重型武器而破坏平衡。

column2: This campaign depicts scenarios in several kinds of terrains and conditions, open field, mountains, cities, etc. You also have big battles with many units on each side and smaller more strategic scenarios.
column3: 本战役的场景涵盖多种地形和条件：开阔地、山地、城市等。你也会遇到双方各有很多单位的大战役，以及规模更小、更讲策略的场景。

column2: This campaign depicts heavy and continuous action. You start fighting from the first term and it will not be over until is over. I sincerely regret if you do not like this kind of scenarios, but everybody is entitled to his own taste.
column3: 本战役描绘的是激烈而连续的战斗。你从第一回合就开始打，直到打完才会结束。如果你不喜欢这类场景，我真心感到遗憾，但每个人都有自己的口味。

column2: This campaign is not an endorsement of any political idea or of war. War is one of the most regrettable human activities. Before discovering Panzerg2 I was a master level chess player. I see the game as a more "colorful" chess.
column3: 本战役并不为任何政治理念或战争背书。战争是人类最令人遗憾的活动之一。在发现 Panzerg2 之前，我是一名大师级国际象棋棋手。我把这个游戏看作一盘更“丰富多彩”的国际象棋。

column2: I really appreciate Mr. Williams Dickens allowing me to retool his excellent British campaign. This campaign was strikingly modern for its time and the designer deserves a lot of credit. A good job done with limited tools. Some scenarios were inspired on similar scenarios designed by Steve Brown for his original British campaign.
column3: 我非常感谢 Williams Dickens 先生允许我改造他出色的英国战役。这个战役在当时相当现代，设计者值得大力称赞。他是在工具很有限的情况下做出了好作品。有些场景的灵感来自 Steve Brown 为他原版英国战役设计的类似场景。

column2: My interest on wargaming design was inspired by the campaign 7PanzerArmee by Mr. Dave Anderson, my appreciation goes to him. After I started the campaign I read the work of many others and it was a great help (Lasse Jensen and Andr eas Seidel among others. I also appreciate the work of so many others who have transformed war-gaming into an art form. Thank you for playing the campaign. I hope you have as much fun playing as I have designed it.
column3: 我对兵棋设计产生兴趣，是受 Dave Anderson 先生的战役 7PanzerArmee 启发，在此向他致谢。开始做这个战役之后，我读了另外许多人的作品，它们帮了大忙(其中有 Lasse Jensen 和 Andreas Seidel)。我也感谢其他众多把兵棋推演变成一种艺术形式的人。感谢你玩这个战役。希望你在玩的时候能和我设计时一样开心。
